Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Answers below are concise so you can paste them into the questionnaire; I attached our short locality policy PDF and a 1-page erasure playbook excerpt for evidence. Happy to expand any item.

1) Geographic hosting: By default requests for hosted API customers are routed to the region closest to the caller (US West, US East, EU-West, APAC-SG depending on customer region). Customers can select or restrict regions at signup. Tenant data (request payloads, model outputs, and derived telemetry) is stored in the customer-selected region; cross-region replication is only used for optional multi-region redundancy and requires explicit customer opt-in.

2) Retention windows: Short-term request logs and telemetry used to operate the service are retained for operational debugging for up to 30 days. Indexed artifacts used for billing/analytics (token-level usage summaries) are retained up to 365 days. Backups and longer-lived operational snapshots are retained no longer than 400 days and are partitioned by region. We offer contract addenda for extended retention needs.

3) Erasure process and timeline: Customer-initiated erasure requests (via Console or support ticket) trigger an automated orchestration: a) mark tenant data for purge, b) delete live objects in the selected region (within 24 hours for standard requests), c) remove indexed references and caches (48–72 hours), d) schedule backup and snapshot expunge (complete within 14 days under normal operations). For high-sensitivity requests we offer an expedited pathway with SLA-backed 72-hour full purge when purchased as an add-on.

4) Attestations & evidence: We provide deletion attestations including time-stamped audit logs and S3 object lifecycle reports. Where customers require, we can produce region-bound proof packages (log extracts, snapshot manifests) delivered via a secured Drive link or DPA-backed request. For regulated customers we also support on-prem data handoff and private deployment options.

Attachments: Redwood_Data_Locality_Policy_v2.pdf (policy summary), erasure_playbook_snippet.txt (timeline + responsibilities).

If this format works, I can produce a 1‑page signable attestation and a short evidence bundle.
